plugin.name: titan-decor
plugin._long: Inti OS window bar: macOS traffic lights on the left, centred title and Titan theme colours. Based on Wayfire's decoration plugin.

option.name: font
option._long: Sets the font to use for the title bars.

option.name: font_color
option._long: Sets the font color to use for the title bars.

option.name: font_scale
option._long: Sets the font scale to use for the title bars.

option.name: title_height
option._long: Sets the height of the title bars in pixels.

option.name: border_size
option._long: Sets the border size in pixels.

option.name: button_order
option._long: Sets the order of the window buttons.

option.name: button_scale
option._long: Sets the scale for window buttons.

option.name: button_padding
option._long: Sets the vertical padding for window buttons.

option.name: follow_titan_theme
option._long: Bar colours from ~/.config/titan/theme.conf (light/dark). If off, active_color, inactive_color and font_color are used.

option.name: active_color
option._long: Sets the color when the window is active.

option.name: inactive_color
option._long: Sets the color when the window is inactive.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Decoration disabled for specified window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria.

option.name: forced_views
option._short: Force decorations for specified window types
option._long: Forces window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria, overriding client decoration preference.
